task:
A fund holds 6683 credits. Its first grant is 17% of that original balance. Return 36% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 8% of the original balance minus 8 credits (the 8 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:

Adjustment 5: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
